title: bypass_secret_ack
description: Confirms that the per-device offline bypass key from `set_bypass_secret` was stored. The server marks the key delivered when the fingerprint matches the key it issued (only on a connection authenticated with the device secret) and stops re-sending it; a mismatch is audit-logged.

fingerprint.description: First 16 lower-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the 32 decoded key bytes.
